title: The waiting page's note box is always open
why: shiv, Oct 30 14:30 CDT (chat): why does the note hide behind an Add a note button? Typing in it should be enough. Read on main (skills/waiting-page/page.html, noteShown): the box opens only after Add a note, None of these, or a saved note; a typed note alone already counts as an answer (draftReady: none plus the note; SKILL.md lines 61-65).
note: Fix: show the note box on every open card and drop the Add a note button (noteShown always true, noteOpen state and its button removed). Triage 12 runs the one-line form as a shortcut in the live page (v34, 14:33 CDT) until this lands. Done check: a card renders the box with no button; typing a note and Send writes choice none plus the note; the page's own tests updated. Needs no answer. Port: yes, every repo with a waiting page.
